title: Vault
notes: Built from the parts of basics/ no piece had touched: polar repetition, boolean subtraction, material-carrying smooth union, hex prisms, cosine palettes. Adds single scattering along the view ray for light shafts — a per-pixel integral, so tiled export stays byte-identical where a post-process bloom would not. Scene SDF kept cheap so the volumetric can afford steps, the opposite trade from 005.
